correctness.rationale: By the classical abelian multiplier formula, for an abelian p-primary component with cyclic factor exponents a_i, M(P) consists of C_{p^{min(a_i,a_j)}} over pairs i<j. An elementary rank-k p-multiplier thus forces k=binom(r,2), and C_p^r gives the converse. For every remaining k, Holt §2 constructs G=N⋊C with N elementary abelian and C cyclic, M(G)=C_p^k; the p^k=4 exception uses a fixed-point-free order-five action. These groups are nonabelian metabelian. Thus delta_p(k)=1 for triangular ranks and 2 otherwise. Checked source proof and independent finite triangular obstruction examples; no finite census is substituted for Holt general construction.
